'''San Andreas Theme Song''' is a song by [[Young Maylay]] (the voice actor for [[Carl Johnson]]) where he raps to the theme from [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. The song is from the album, [[:wp:San Andreas: The Original Mixtape|San Andreas: The Original Mixtape]]. Only the background music (which is the theme) is heard in the game. It is also heard backwards.
